description: This file defines the MarketplaceCommerceAnalyticsClient class, a client for the AWS Marketplace Commerce Analytics service, extending the AwsClient base class and providing methods such as generateDataSet and startSupportDataExport.

classes.name: MarketplaceCommerceAnalyticsClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Marketplace Commerce Analytics service, extending from AwsClient.

methods.name: generateDataSet
methods.description: Creates a data set within the AWS Marketplace Commerce Analytics service.

methods.name: generateDataSetAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a data set within the AWS Marketplace Commerce Analytics service.

methods.name: startSupportDataExport
methods.description: Starts the support data export process within the AWS Marketplace Commerce Analytics service.

methods.name: startSupportDataExportAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously starts the support data export process.
